name: Christensen’s Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) Brand Placement
diagnostic: What functional, emotional, and social 'job' is the customer hiring our brand to resolve, and what incumbent habits or solutions must be 'fired'?
artifact: A JTBD Forces of Progress Blueprint mapping the push of the current situation, the pull of the new solution, the anxiety of change, and the inertia of existing habits.
trap: Defining the brand's addressable market solely through demographic profiles rather than the situational triggers that drive buying decisions.

origin.line: Clayton M. Christensen, Scott Cook & Taddy Hall (2016)

pedigreeFull: Clayton M. Christensen, Scott Cook, & Taddy Hall (*Competing Against Luck*, 2016; Harvard Business School). A theory asserting that customers purchase solutions to make progress against specific, recurring life situations.
artifactFull: A JTBD Forces of Progress Blueprint mapping the push of the current situation, the pull of the new solution, the anxiety of change, and the inertia of existing habits.
trapFull: Defining the brand's addressable market solely through demographic profiles rather than the situational triggers that drive buying decisions.
